description: This file contains frontend-only rule selectors for a software project, including functions to normalize references, extract target layers and legacy system references from registry entries, determine if rules reference specific systems, and fetch rules applicable to a given system in a deterministic and pure manner.

methods.name: normalizeRefs(value)
methods.description: Normalizes various value shapes (string, number, array, object) into a flat list of string references.

methods.name: extractTargetLayersFromRule(entry)
methods.description: Extracts target layer references from a registry entry.

methods.name: extractLegacySystemRefsFromRule(entry)
methods.description: Extracts legacy system reference strings from a registry entry for backward compatibility.

methods.name: ruleReferencesSystem(entry, system)
methods.description: Determines whether a given rule registry entry references a specific system.

methods.name: compareStringsDeterministic(a, b)
methods.description: Provides a deterministic string comparison function without relying on locale.

methods.name: compareRuleMetadataDeterministic(a, b, registryIndexByIdentity)
methods.description: Provides a deterministic comparator for rule metadata entries, ensuring stable ordering.

methods.name: getRulesForSystem(system)
methods.description: Public function that returns a deterministic, filtered, and ordered list of rule metadata entries referencing a specific system.
